study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissecting task-based fMRI activity using normative modelling: an application to the Emotional Face Matching Task

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The authors used Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) to create normative models predicting voxel-wise BOLD activation during the Emotional Face Matching Task. The models were implemented using the PCNtoolkit (Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit) software v0.26.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we fit a Bayesian Linear Regression model that predicted the single subject level activation for each voxel of the brain, as a function of sex, age, and acquisition and task parameters... by training a Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) model to predict BOLD signal for the faces>shapes contrast... This was performed in the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit (PCNtoolkit) software v0.26
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Savage2024.pdf.md: Results / Fitting reference normative models for emotional face processing; Methods / Normative models

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The response variables were z-statistic maps from task-based fMRI contrasts: (1) faces>shapes contrast and (2) faces>baseline contrast from the Emotional Face Matching Task (EFMT). These represent task-evoked BOLD activation patterns.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The z-statistic maps from the contrast face>shapes (contrast vector [1, -1]; 5 mm smoothed in standard space), for each subject, were used as response variables for the normative models... We created normative models of EFMT-related BOLD activation maps... We also created models to predict BOLD signal for the faces condition alone (i.e. face>baseline contrast vector [1, 0])

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative models included the following covariates: site, age, sex, intra-cranial volume (ICV), acquisition parameters (TR, multiband sequence, number of volumes collected), and task parameters (task length, number of target blocks, instructions for faces condition, target stimuli set).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We created normative models of EFMT-related BOLD activation maps, as a function of site, age, sex, intra-cranial volume, and acquisition [TR, multiband sequence, number of volumes collected (per run where applicable)] and task parameters [task length (in seconds, and per run where applicable), number of target blocks, instructions for faces condition, and the target stimuli (i.e. which stimulus set they came from)]
